selection.purpose: targeted mechanisms and matched controls; not prevalence estimation

checkpoints.name: first_five_pilot_cases
observations: Distinguish explicit-task flag omission from other preserved channels.
Missing Payments after no flag is not a protective stop.
Propagation follows next decisive turn; terminal Payments is local.
No-error rows have empty propagation and an observed stopper or nobody.

locator_convention: Archive member names are literal; evidence_lines, context_lines and delegation_return_line are one-based JSONL lines. context_lines identify earlier delegation results available to the orchestrator; they are not newly observed results in the current turn.

agreement.reason: First annotator file was not found in the repository; no agreement was measured.

review_method: Two disjoint case allocations, coordinator review of every annotated turn, periodic checkpoints and targeted independent semantic checks. This is one coordinated annotation pass, not two independent ratings of each row.

working_conventions.protective_skip_signal: Empty when Payments was deliberately not invoked after a hold/escalation; not an absent or dropped signal.
working_conventions.routine_delegation_decision: платить means the orchestrator chose to route the invoice to Payments; it is not proof that a transfer happened.
working_conventions.propagation: Next decisive annotated turn, not the final workflow outcome; no-error/uncertain propagation is empty.
working_conventions.uncertainty: не уверена, confidence 1, empty primary MAST/FinBot, alternatives in comment.

review.limitation: Selective primary-source review, not a second full semantic annotation; source/citation/hash checks were performed separately by the coordinator.

final_independent_review.scope: review corrections against4393419; all17 modified rows and reusable protocol, followed by recheck of three corrected review issues
resolved_followup_issues: target verdicts removed from codebook journal
literal1.2 rule retained without sole-cause condition
final_independent_review.limitation: Scoped semantic delta review, not a second full annotation or repeated source-hash validation.
